newsitem.title: USA: CME S&P 500 index futures fall 15.00 point limit.
newsitem.headline: CME S&P 500 index futures fall 15.00 point limit.

text.p: June S&P 500 stock index futures at the Chicago Mercantile Exchange fell the 15.00 point lower limit in afternoon activity.

The limit was in effect until 1421 CST/2021 GMT, at which point there was a two-minute trading halt. After 1430 CST a 45-point limit went into effect. Coordinated trading halts go into effect if the Dow falls 350 points, a CME official said.
Technical selling fueled declines. Weaker bond prices, after stronger than expected U.S. housing data this morning, triggered selling in index futures earlier.
